artworks.title: The Snow Drift
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Peter De Wint
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is in the upper third of the composition, with snow-capped mountains in the distance under swirling clouds. Close by are trees with thick, gnarled trunks and branches, depicted with textured brushstrokes. In the foreground, two figures on horseback are traversing rough terrain. The palette is monochrome grayscale, creating a weighty and atmospheric mood with dark shadows contrasting against lighter areas.

artworks.title: A Sussex Down
artworks.medium: mezzotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching of a pastoral scene viewed from a slightly elevated point. The horizon is positioned lower in the composition, allowing for a vast expanse of sky to dominate the image. Two figures are depicted working on an open field. In the distance, a large windmill stands prominently on the horizon to the right, its sails juxtaposing against the sky, while another windmill is visible even further back on the right edge. The brushstrokes in the sky are smooth and sweeping, creating billowing clouds. The overall color palette consists of grayscale tones, emphasizing contrasts and textures, giving the scene a somber yet timeless quality.

artworks.title: A Yorkshire Road
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Peter De Wint
artworks.medium: mezzotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with distant hills on the horizon, a sloping land to the left, and a line of trees or shrubs in the middle against a cloudy sky. The sky has dynamic clouds in swirling brushstrokes, and a monochromatic color palette of gray contrasts lighter clouds with darker land below. There are indistinct vegetation shapes in the foreground, including a lighter patch that may represent a structure, with darker land merging with the sky in the distance.

artworks.title: Hayfield in Yorkshire
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Peter De Wint
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with various activities happening close by. People and animals, possibly cattle, are seen moving through a body of water while a cart is being pulled by horses. The scene is bustling with movement. Rolling hills are visible in the distance above the horizon. The sky is filled with fluffy clouds, allowing sunlight to stream down onto the landscape. The brushstrokes are soft and sweeping, giving a sense of fluidity and peace. The color palette is monochromatic with dark and light tones highlighting textures and elements, adding visual depth and dynamism to the piece.

artworks.title: Moonlight on a River
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Joseph Mallord William Turner
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a body of water with a low horizon in the center. A tall silhouette, possibly a water tower or chimney, is prominent on the horizon. There are indistinct architectural forms to the right, potentially part of a bridge. The style features loose brushstrokes blending the scene elements, creating an ethereal quality. The color palette is limited to sepia tones. On the left, there are shadowy figures near a boat on the water. The cloudy sky fills the top, with a luminous full moon partly obscured by clouds, reflecting in the water and contributing to the somber mood.

artworks.title: A Roman Canal
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Peter De Wint
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a cloudy sky dominating the top part of the picture. A line of trees marks the horizon in the distance. Near the foreground, there is a path along a riverbank where figures and horses are loading hay onto a cart and a boat. The style is monochrome with detailed brushstrokes showcasing textures. The color palette consists of shades of gray and brown.

artworks.title: The Mouth of the Thames—Isle of Sheppey in Distance
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Joseph Mallord William Turner
artworks.medium: mezzotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows the sea from a low vantage point just above the water. The horizon is low, with the sky dominating the upper part of the image. In the distance, several sailing ships are navigating the water, with their sails partially unfurled. The brushstrokes give a soft quality to the waves and ships. The color palette is sepia tones, creating a vintage atmosphere. The clouds are dense, giving an impression of impending weather contrasting with the lighter hues in the water.

artworks.title: The Mummer
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated, shown from the waist up. He has a prominent nose and a wrinkled face. His lips are closed, and he has a furrowed brow. The man wears a tall top hat casting a shadow over his face. He has a heavy coat and is holding a long, thin object, possibly a cane or walking stick. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Brangwyn
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a man in a seated position, facing right. He has a beard, short hair, and is holding a brush in his right hand. He is wearing a loose-fitting garment and is surrounded by jars and containers. The background is plain.

artworks.title: George Bernard Shaw
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, in profile facing left. He has a full beard, mustache, short hair, a prominent forehead, and a strong jawline. He wears a suit jacket and tie, with a plain background. No visible jewelry or objects are present.

artworks.title: Strapwork and Foliage Ornament on Dark Ground with Monkeys and other Animals
artworks.description: The image shows ornate lines and shapes forming an abstract pattern. Swirling lines and leaf-like motifs create the pattern, with a central circular object featuring face-like features. Symmetrical figures resembling mythical creatures or animals intertwine with the foliage above and below. The design merges abstract elements with suggestions of animals in symmetrical harmony.

artworks.title: Mvsica (Music)
artworks.description: The image shows a female figure in a floating position in the sky. She is facing slightly to the right with one arm extended. She has flowing hair and is dressed in robes cinched at the waist. Two cherubic figures accompany her. The background features swirling clouds and stars. Below her is a landscape with small buildings and trees.

artworks.title: Gramatica (Grammar)
artworks.description: The drawing depicts an allegorical figure set in a detailed sky scene. The central figure represents "Grammatica," as indicated by the inscription. The figure is surrounded by winged cherubs, one holding a scroll with "LIBET" inscribed on it, within swirling clouds and framed by stars and ornate patterns. Below the figure is a landscape with a castle and trees. The figure's flowing garments and surrounding elements suggest movement. The drawing utilizes intricate lines and shading to convey depth and texture, in the style of allegorical art.

artworks.title: Astrologia (Astrology)
artworks.description: The image contains swirling lines and shapes, creating an abstract scene with a central figure suspended in motion amidst billowing clouds. The word "ASTROLOGIA" is inscribed above. The main figure is surrounded by circular and ribbon-like curves, suggesting movement and grace. Smaller winged figures hover nearby, one holding an instrument and another with a set of scales. The background features architectural elements like columns and a serene landscape.

artworks.title: Rhetorica (Rhetoric)
artworks.description: The image shows an allegorical figure surrounded by clouds and accompanied by cherubs. The main figure is depicted as a draped female form with her head turned slightly, set against a background of swirling clouds. Two cherubs flank her, one holding a book or tablet and the other carrying a scroll. Below the clouds is a detailed depiction of a town with variously shaped rooftops, spires, and trees. The word “RHETORICA” is inscribed at the top.

artworks.title: Dialectica (Dialectics)
artworks.description: This is a drawing titled "DIALECTICA". It features a personified representation of Dialectics amidst clouds and decorative elements. The word "DIALECTICA" is inscribed above the figure. In the background, there is an idyllic landscape with trees and a building. The foreground has cherubs and celestial symbols, one holding a pair of scales. The style of the drawing resembles Renaissance-period engravings or woodcuts.

artworks.title: Artihmetria (Arithmetic)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a representation of arithmetic. The central figure is a woman draped in flowing garments, surrounded by clouds and ornate designs. She holds a ribbon-like object that wraps around her, featuring symbols including an hourglass and mathematical figures. Above her, the word "ARITHMETRIA" is inscribed in bold letters. In the background, cherubic figures float among the clouds, holding geometrical diagrams. Below is a landscape with castle-like buildings set against hills and trees. The style is detailed and fine, resembling Renaissance engravings.

artworks.title: Geometria (Geometry)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical representation of geometry. The image depicts a central figure standing atop clouds, surrounded by swirling draperies and ornate patterns. The figure holds a compass while two cherubic figures hold instruments associated with geometry. Below the clouds is a detailed landscape with buildings. The title "GEOMATRIA" is displayed at the top.

artworks.title: Spring
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession featuring mythological and symbolic figures. The image portrays a vibrant tableau in classical style, with a series of figures and creatures positioned along a horizontal panel. To the left are depictions of classical gods or mythological entities. They are followed by a procession of figures holding scientific or musical instruments. At the center, a character sits in a chariot-like structure, drawn by fantastical beasts. To the right, other figures interact with large bovine creatures under a tree. The scene is rich with classical iconography, ornamental details, and interlaced with natural elements like trees and clouds.

artworks.title: The Enclosed Valley
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint printed in brown on laid paper mounted on later laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from an elevated vantage point. The horizon is placed near the top of the image, showing jagged lines of distant mountains. The artwork uses intricate line work typical of etching, creating texture and depth across the rocky surfaces. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of beige and brown. The rocky terrain closest to us is rough and textured, leading into a middle section with more rocks and sparse vegetation. In the distant background, softer lines fade against the sky.

artworks.title: Rudyard Kipling
artworks.description: The image shows an etched portrait of a man's upper body. He is seated in a side profile view, facing right, with his arms crossed over his chest. The man has a mustache, glasses, short, neatly combed hair, and is wearing a suit jacket. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing at a table with his left arm resting on it. He is holding a piece of paper in his right hand. He has a mustache and short, combed back hair, wearing a suit with a tie, vest, and jacket. On the table are papers, an inkwell, and a pen. Behind him is an industrial press with a wooden wheel, and to his right is an open book displaying a portrait of another person. The background is simple, focusing on the workspace with the press and scattered papers.

artworks.title: River View
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash on  laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a river flowing towards a multi-arched bridge in the distance. The horizon meets the sky at the top third of the image, where mountains are visible. The scene is drawn in a sketchy and detailed style, with fine lines and cross-hatching showing the texture of trees, buildings, and water. Washes and shading in sepia tones give the drawing a monochromatic and warm appearance. Buildings line the riverbank, and architecture can be seen on the hills. The river is shown with diagonal lines indicating movement towards the bridge under the contour of distant hills.

artworks.title: The Court Rules
artworks.description: The image shows a half-body portrait of a person seated at a table. The individual faces slightly to the side, with a focused expression. They have short, wavy hair and wear formal attire with a bow tie. The person holds a pair of glasses in one hand resting on an open book on the table. The background is plain with a shadow cast behind the person.
